item.title: Buffalo State University employee says understaffing has led to delay in snow removal
item.description: Buffalo State University students have reached out to us here at 7 News, sharing their frustrations about snow cleanup on campus. A university employee told us that understaffing has led to delays.

item.title: Special election for 61st State Senate seat heats up
item.description: A high-stakes special election happening on February 3 determines who represents New York's 61st State Senate District.

item.title: School districts consider calendar, safety when making snow day decisions
item.description: With another round of dangerous bitter cold and snow, school leaders are already watching conditions closely for parents wondering whether schools will be open on Friday.

item.title: 'That's disturbing': Buffalo public housing residents endure freezing temperatures without heat or hot water
item.description: Buffalo public housing residents are sleeping in coats and boiling water for showers after losing heat during this bitter cold stretch. Buffalo Councilmember Leah Halton-Pope wants accountability.
